# iTabs

> iTabs makes order-ahead menu pages for small cafes, drive-thrus, food stalls and lunch bars in Australia. Customers scan a QR code or tap a link, order on their phone with no app, and the shop's team sees the order straight away. iTabs charges no commission.

## What it does
- Each shop gets its own order-ahead page, e.g. shopname.itabs.co
- Customers pick items, add their name (and car, for drive-thrus) and send the order
- Staff see new orders on a staff screen with a sound alert, and can print tickets
- Owners change prices and mark items sold out themselves
- Menus are readable by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok), so people can find the shop and order through AI

## Who it's for
Small, independent food shops: drive-thru coffee, cafes, market stalls, food courts, hospital and workplace cafes.

## Price
First month free, then $29 a month per shop. No commission on orders. No lock-in contract, cancel anytime.

## Try it
- Demo: https://try.itabs.co
- AI ordering demo: https://alert4.itabs.co
